name: $\mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{RS}}$-non-private heterogeneous scheme

label: thm:drs_reduction
title: Theorem
body_md:
\label{thm:drs_reduction}
    If there exists an $(N, NK, \mathbf{M}_{\text{exp}}, \mathbf{F}, R)$
    $\mathcal{D}_{\mathcal{RS}}$-non-private heterogeneous scheme, then there exists
    an $(N, K, \mathbf{M}, \mathbf{F}, R)$-private heterogeneous
    scheme.

label: thm:exact_tradeoff
title: Theorem
head: environment

label: cor:thm_exact_N_K_2
title: Corollary
body_md:
\label{cor:thm_exact_N_K_2}
For $F_1\geq F_0$, the exact demand-private
memory-rate region is obtained by exchanging
$F_0$ and $F_1$ in
\Cref{thm:exact_tradeoff}.
head: environment

title: Proof
body_md:
For $F_1\geq F_0$, relabel the files as
$W_0'=W_1$ and $W_1'=W_0$, and the demands
as $D_k'=1-D_k$ for $k\in[2]$.
This relabeling is a bijection on $[2]^2$
that preserves the uniform demand distribution,
decodability, and demand privacy, without
changing the cache capacities or transmission rate.
The result therefore follows from
\Cref{thm:exact_tradeoff}.
